item.title: Trump nominates Justice Department official to a EEOC seat that was left open by Democrat's firing
item.description: President Donald Trump has nominated a Justice Department official to an open seat on the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission, signaling the administration's intention to forge ahead with its legal campaign against diversity and inclusion policies.

item.title: US charges 3 men with plotting terror attacks, including planned assault on UK airbase
item.description: U.S. authorities have charged three men with plotting a campaign of nearly 20 attacks targeting Jewish communities in Europe and the U.S., along with a British military base, RAF Fairford.

item.title: A note to ‘46’: Donald Trump’s private message to Joe Biden emerges in new White House memoir
item.description: Former President Joe Biden is releasing a new memoir in which President Donald Trump privately praised Biden in a letter left for him as he departed office in January 2021.

item.title: Thomas Markle, father of Meghan, cut off his ankle monitor, DOJ says
item.description: A prosecutor says 82-year-old estranged father of Meghan, the Duchess of Sussex, cut an electronic monitoring device off his ankle, just days after his arrest for keeping child sexual abuse material in storage units in California.
